items.context: Kya aapko international roaming activate karna hai
items.text: haan ji
nahi ji

items.context: Kab se aapko roaming chalu karna hai
items.text: abhi chahiye
umm mera phone Dubai me use karna hai toh roaming chahiye
woh mujhe Indian number pe bhi roaming activate karwani hai
accha agar main Friday ko travel karu toh Friday se chalega kya
haan ji mujhe international roaming activate karni hai please
matlab mera number automatic roaming pe set kar do
main Kolkata se Delhi ja raha hu kal raat tak chalu kar do
mera balance 200 rupaye hai uske hisab se charge kitne lagenge

items.context: For how many days do you want roaming activated?
items.text: haan mujhe 10 din ke liye international roaming activate karna hai

items.context: Kab se aap roaming chalu karna chahte hain?
items.text: nahi Thursday nahi Wednesday ko activate karwana hai

items.context: Aapka plan prepaid hai ya postpaid?
items.text: mera plan prepaid hai kya roaming ke liye alag se bill lagega

items.context: Kya aap chahte hain ki roaming automatic renew ho?
items.text: accha bhai ji automatic renewal hota hai kya roaming ka

items.context: Aap kis city se travel kar rahe hain?
items.text: woh main Mumbai se London ja raha hu isliye activate karwana hai
merko thoda help chahiye yeh international roaming plan activate karwane mein main UAE ja raha hu agle hafte
mera number 9876543210 hai aur main plan samajh nahi pa raha hu ki kaunsa best rahega mere liye
dekh bhai mein pehle ghar se bahar kab ja paun yeh pata nahi toh thoda flexible toh kar do roaming plan main

items.context: Thoda thoda bataiye ki kaha travel karna hai aur kitne din ke liye?
items.text: accha sir aapke number pe ek baar verify kar lete hain phir activation karte hain

items.context: Kya aap mujhe apka current plan bata sakte hain?
items.text: ji mujhe apka current plan samajhna hai fir sahi roaming activate karenge

items.context: Aap apne travel plan ke baare mein bata sakte hain?
items.text: main Delhi se ja raha hoon par Mumbai se bhi kuch din rukna hai toh dono jagah ke liye kaise chalega

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: roaming - wants to activate international or national roaming
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
